subject: Strange effect of x=(xxx) vs. x=xxx

messages.author: 3a775dfa0a96bf95
messages.subject: Strange effect of x=(xxx) vs. x=xxx
parts:
Works fine:

ggplot(diamonds,mapping=aes(x=carat)) + stat_bin(aes(y=x*..count..))

Works fine:

ggplot(diamonds,mapping=aes(x=(carat))) + stat_bin(aes(y=x*..count..))

Works fine (with warning):

ggplot(diamonds,mapping=aes(x=carat)) + stat_bin(aes(y=log10(..count..)))

Gives error:

ggplot(diamonds,mapping=aes(x=(carat))) + stat_bin(aes(y=log10(..count..)))
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object "..count.." not found
